## Decisions (recorded at implementation)

- **Steering park is `waiting_gate` + `paused_at`, no gate row.** `requestPause` only flags
  `runs.pause_requested_at` while `running`; `commitStep` checks the flag at the committed
  phase boundary — the in-flight phase finishes, then the run transitions
  `running → waiting_gate` with `paused_at` stamped and `pause_requested_at` cleared. No gate
  opens: a real approval wait is `waiting_gate` + `paused_at IS NULL`, and the resume endpoint
  answers `409 gate_waiting` for it (steering can never resolve a real gate).
- **Resume-with-note and queue-note share `Guidance{source:'queued_message', run_id}`** —
  written in the same transaction as the resume/state change; run-scoped guidance is consumed
  at the next boundary and can never reach an independence context (REQ-RUN-18).
- **Walkthrough: one package-class call, lazily enqueued.** `GET /projects/:id/timeline`
  enqueues `walkthrough:<runId>` (singleton key) for every delivered run lacking a record —
  grouped rounds AND `ungrouped`. `WalkthroughGenerator` (`apps/worker`) calls
  `claude-haiku-4-5` (≤400 max tokens) with only artifact identity/shape + structured run
  facts — no prompts, transcripts, reasoning, or source-note bodies; the 200-word cap is
  enforced mechanically post-call. A failed call writes `status:'failed'` metadata (no endless
  worker retry); `POST /runs/:id/walkthrough/retry` clears the record and re-enqueues.
  Secret: `WALKTHROUGH_MODEL_KEY_SECRET` via worker env — never reaches web/client.
- **ETA band (ledger K4):** `etaBandForPhases` projects the mean committed-step duration over
  the phases still to run (×[0.8, 1.5], whole minutes; 5-min flat prior until the run has
  history; `off` phases never count). Wired at the api card-build seam for
  `running`/`cancelling` only; the view model normalizes absent → `null`.
- **Feed rows share one formatter.** `packages/ide/src/feed-row.ts` formats SSR + browser rows
  identically; density values are the contract's `summary`/`normal`/`verbose` (Details tab =
  `normal`); uncatalogued event types fail closed; Verbose renders behind
  `data-tier="advanced"`. SSE is same-origin (`/p/:project/r/:run/events` proxy forwards
  `after` + `Last-Event-ID`; the island reconnects with `?after=<lastSeq>`).
- **Report levels are separate read models.** Level 3 (`run-report.ts`) = header,
  estimate-vs-actual, flags (server-computed trigger strings only), phase bars, seat split
  with subagent labels, claims + cost-per-verified-claim, cost drivers, suggested guidance.
  Level 4 (`?advanced=1`) adds the phase × seat × model-tier table with tokens + provider
  request ids — Level 3's DTO cannot carry them (a contract test asserts the shape).
- **Web steering is progressive-enhancement POSTs** that swallow stale 400/404/409 and
  redirect back to `/p/:slug` — a stale card re-renders the current state instead of erroring.
- **The verbs row** (§5.5's `[Draft ▾] [Review ▾] [Revise ▾]`) renders at the pane top; each
  verb opens the run sheet at `/p/:slug/run?workflow=<verb>`.
